purpose: Define runtime UserModule instances as stable logical instances bound explicitly to local or relation-backed data/context without conflating the instance with its module definition.

topics.name: UserModule Instances
topics.purpose: Define runtime UserModule instances as stable logical instances bound explicitly to local or relation-backed data/context without conflating the instance with its module definition.

semantics.definition_instance_rule: UserModule definition identity and instance identity are distinct.
semantics.local_rule: local binds the instance to its own local data/context.
semantics.relation_rule: relation binding requires an explicitly predeclared relation/FK semantic owned by the relevant Meta/schema.
semantics.no_implicit_relation_rule: Runtime does not invent relation semantics to satisfy a binding.
semantics.instance_scope_rule: Local data isolation is scoped to the full #UM instance.
semantics.multiple_instances_rule: Multiple instances are allowed only when the module/owning contract explicitly supports them.

invariants.rule: UserModule identity, type, lifecycle, bindings and visibility are explicit canonical/runtime semantics.

hard_gates.condition: instance identity conflated with module definition identity
relation binding created without predeclared relation/FK semantics
local instance data leaks across instance boundaries
multiple instances created where module semantics do not permit them

references.purpose: Instances derive from registered module definitions.
relation-backed bindings rely on explicit structural relation semantics.

prose.summary: Define runtime UserModule instances as stable logical instances bound explicitly to local or relation-backed data/context without conflating the instance with its module definition.
